reason: Reads the distinctness requirement as forbidding a Postgres parse result; verifier says it binds only config/migration/observability. Hair-splitting, since consumers branch on driver.
Right API and parse result, but the suffix index for '5.4.0-foo' is 5 (the hyphen), not 6.
Requirement 3 names domains that must work; the claim misreads it as imposing an exclusivity restriction the requirement never states.
Misstates the diff contract: results contain only additions/removals, so updated CVEs are excluded, not always included.
Described comparisons are correct, but the proposed check omits the required compiled-Qt (QT_VERSION) clause, accepting compiled Qt below 5.12.
Doc generators iterate sorted(configdata.DATA.values()), so output order is sorted, not configdata insertion order.
Holds only when the server does not force encryption; server-forced policy wins, leaving the toggle checked yet disabled.
getStatus uses uid, lastonline and status; the claim misstates its input as including online and settings.
Baseline signal_name parses sig.signal with a regex, even under supported PyQt 5.10; no repr() parsing existed.
Import path also sets the generated Go package name and, with paths=import, the output filename; 'only cross-file imports' omits these.
The raw route adds only middleware.assert.room; assert.message is on the neighboring non-raw message route.
Editing .proto and swagger.json alone omits regenerating flipt.pb.go/gateway and assigning reasons in evaluator branches.
Begin/rollback/commit skeleton is right as far as it goes but omits ExecuteTx's required retry of retryable CockroachDB errors.
Square is not ignored at size 0 under the contract; passing a.square is not interchangeable with false.
In go-redis v9.0.5 the ReadTimeout switch maps -1 to 0 and 0 to 3 seconds, not the claimed mapping.
Most Postgres migrations may carry over, but migration 1's DROP CONSTRAINT on a UNIQUE constraint fails on CockroachDB.
The leading '2' is a fixed signal marker (0x32) prepended to the signature, not a meta-object signal index.
Room creation is right, but newRoom adds a user-join system message, so a message is stored; the claim overlooks it.
A tag is needed only when the key differs from the lowercased field name; untagged fields still bind via the fallback.
rawDescData holds raw wire bytes at init; it becomes gzipped only after rawDescGZIP() runs, yet the claim is unconditional.
Unchanged diff never emits previous-only CVEs and lacks plus/minus booleans; later filtering cannot add them, so required diff changes are omitted.
Default is https://proxy.golang.org,direct; claim drops scheme and direct fallback. Refutation is pedantic for an informal shorthand.
Success also requires authorization for raw messages and valid pagination for room lists; valid identifiers alone do not guarantee it.
LinkedIn part is right, but the requirement mandates test-domain coverage too; 'possibly' leaves that required coverage out.
Line 142 is the cache-hit branch that unmarshals a response; the field assignments are at lines 85-87 in EvaluationUnaryInterceptor.
Message 1 exists as a stored user-join system message, and the envelope uses status {code:'ok'}, not 'success' with null content.
No strict-mode case or config.DiffModeStrict exists in getDiffCves; the agent recalled nonexistent code. Maps initialize unconditionally.
The contract says square controls output with no size exception; square=true at default size 0 must still return a square image.
Only isCveInfoUpdated is called in baseline getDiffCves; the isCveFixed branch is commented out.
In go-redis v9.0.5 internal/pool.Options has ConnMaxIdleTime; no IdleTimeout field exists there.
Qt 5.15 documents fromString with an optional int *suffixIndex out parameter, and PyQt exposes it as a tuple.
Status checks exist, but the script also asserts body fields (flagKey, segmentKey, match, value); the claim overlooks them.
Verifier says controller defaults pagination before api.chats.list, so a controller change is also needed; but API-level validation may be what tests exercise.
No separate socket.io/chats module exists; chat methods are defined as SocketModules.chats inside src/socket.io/modules.js.
Verifier flags DiffMinus '-.' but the period is sentence punctuation from normalization; the quoted code shows '-', matching the requirement.
Routing CockroachDB to postgres.WithInstance fails: the Postgres adapter's Lock uses pg_advisory_lock, which CockroachDB does not support.
privateShouldBeEncrypted reads only the .well-known default; server forcing is queried separately and only sets canChangeEncryption.
The requirement changes updated-CVE handling: results contain only additions/removals, so preserving updated entries violates the contract.
getPrivateRoomId passes the raw uid to hasPrivateChat and parses the returned room id afterwards; parseInt is not its argument.
The test iterates stringToDriver keys and baseline has no cockroach key; it does not reference config/migrations/cockroach.
